CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `byline_current_documents` AS with `sq` as (select `byline_document_versions`.`id` AS `id`,`byline_document_versions`.`document_id` AS `document_id`,`byline_document_versions`.`collection_id` AS `collection_id`,`byline_document_versions`.`collection_version` AS `collection_version`,`byline_document_versions`.`event_type` AS `event_type`,`byline_document_versions`.`status` AS `status`,`byline_document_versions`.`is_deleted` AS `is_deleted`,`byline_document_versions`.`created_at` AS `created_at`,`byline_document_versions`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,`byline_document_versions`.`created_by` AS `created_by`,`byline_document_versions`.`change_summary` AS `change_summary`,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY `byline_document_versions`.`document_id` ORDER BY `byline_document_versions`.`id` desc )  AS `rn` from `byline_document_versions` where (`byline_document_versions`.`is_deleted` = false)) select `sq`.`id` AS `id`,`sq`.`document_id` AS `document_id`,`sq`.`collection_id` AS `collection_id`,`sq`.`collection_version` AS `collection_version`,`sq`.`event_type` AS `event_type`,`sq`.`status` AS `status`,`sq`.`is_deleted` AS `is_deleted`,`sq`.`created_at` AS `created_at`,`sq`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,`sq`.`created_by` AS `created_by`,`sq`.`change_summary` AS `change_summary`,`byline_documents`.`order_key` AS `order_key`,`byline_documents`.`source_locale` AS `source_locale` from (`sq` join `byline_documents` on((`byline_documents`.`id` = `sq`.`document_id`))) where (`sq`.`rn` = 1)

CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `byline_current_published_documents` AS with `sq` as (select `byline_document_versions`.`id` AS `id`,`byline_document_versions`.`document_id` AS `document_id`,`byline_document_versions`.`collection_id` AS `collection_id`,`byline_document_versions`.`collection_version` AS `collection_version`,`byline_document_versions`.`event_type` AS `event_type`,`byline_document_versions`.`status` AS `status`,`byline_document_versions`.`is_deleted` AS `is_deleted`,`byline_document_versions`.`created_at` AS `created_at`,`byline_document_versions`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,`byline_document_versions`.`created_by` AS `created_by`,`byline_document_versions`.`change_summary` AS `change_summary`,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY `byline_document_versions`.`document_id` ORDER BY `byline_document_versions`.`id` desc )  AS `rn` from `byline_document_versions` where ((`byline_document_versions`.`is_deleted` = false) and (`byline_document_versions`.`status` = 'published'))) select `sq`.`id` AS `id`,`sq`.`document_id` AS `document_id`,`sq`.`collection_id` AS `collection_id`,`sq`.`collection_version` AS `collection_version`,`sq`.`event_type` AS `event_type`,`sq`.`status` AS `status`,`sq`.`is_deleted` AS `is_deleted`,`sq`.`created_at` AS `created_at`,`sq`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,`sq`.`created_by` AS `created_by`,`sq`.`change_summary` AS `change_summary`,`byline_documents`.`order_key` AS `order_key`,`byline_documents`.`source_locale` AS `source_locale` from (`sq` join `byline_documents` on((`byline_documents`.`id` = `sq`.`document_id`))) where (`sq`.`rn` = 1)
